purpose: Implement W1-A Organization Capability Authority as an additive PostgreSQL-authoritative shadow contour without changing registration, Role Eligibility verdicting, Deal, Settlement or external-provider behavior.
requiredInvariants: ROLE_ELIGIBILITY_REGRESSION=0; W1-A may consume current server-held verdict evidence read-only but never changes Role Eligibility policy, state or enforcement.
Exactly the 13 canonical OrganizationCapability codes from the final post-registration specification are accepted; unknown codes fail closed.
No capability assignment is backfilled or inferred from registration role, UI state, client claims or provider configuration.
Organization capability authority is PostgreSQL-authoritative, tenant-scoped and FORCE-RLS protected.
Capability writes use expected-version CAS, payload-bound idempotency and one transaction for assignment, chained canonical audit and canonical outbox.
Evidence-required capabilities remain PENDING unless a current server-held eligible verdict can be resolved; declaration-only capabilities never masquerade as externally verified.
Canonical public audit_events and outbox_entries are extended rather than duplicated.
No provider hard-code, production mock, client-selected tenant, money authority or external success claim is introduced.
No external partner message is sent and no new paid dependency is introduced.
acceptance: Closed registry contains SELL_CROP, BUY_CROP, OWN_TRANSPORT, PROVIDE_LOGISTICS, PROVIDE_EXPEDITION, STORE_CROP, PROVIDE_ELEVATOR_SERVICES, PROVIDE_LAB_TESTING, PROVIDE_SURVEYING, PROVIDE_FINANCING, PROVIDE_INSURANCE, ACCOUNTING_INTEGRATION and API_INTEGRATION exactly once.
Migration creates additive assignment and command-receipt authority without inserting any organization grant.
Assignments and receipts have ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY plus FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and current tenant/current organization policies.
Same idempotency key plus same payload replays the persisted result; same key plus different payload fails closed.
Concurrent or stale expectedVersion fails closed without a partial audit/outbox write.
Cross-tenant access fails closed under PostgreSQL RLS.
Every successful state mutation writes one chained canonical audit event and one canonical outbox entry in the same database transaction.
Evidence-required enable requests without server-held proof result in PENDING, not ACTIVE.
Registration and Role Eligibility regression guards remain green.
